The '''2011 Copa del Rey final''' was the 109th final since [[Copa del Rey|the tournament]]'s establishment (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The match was a traditional '[[El Clásico]]' rivalry between [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] and [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] which took place on 20 April 2011 at the [[Mestalla Stadium]] in [[Valencia]], making it the sixth such Copa del Rey final (the most recent in April 1990 at the same venue), just four days after the two teams played each other in [[La Liga]] and seven days before they met in the [[2010–11 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]] semi-final first leg.

Real Madrid lifted the trophy for the 18th time in their history with a 1–0 victory after extra time. It was Real Madrid's first win in 18 years, having last won the Copa del Rey in [[1993 Copa del Rey final|1993]] against [[Real Zaragoza]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rfef.es/index.jsp?nodo=119&ID=1304 |title=El Real Madrid levantó la Copa del Rey en Mestalla |date=21 April 2011 |publisher=Real Federación Española de Fútbol |access-date=21 April 2011 |language=es |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110429072822/http://www.rfef.es/index.jsp?nodo=119&ID=1304 |archive-date=29 April 2011 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Bar0-1RM">{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/13110141|title=Barcelona 0-1 Real Madrid|date=21 April 2011|work=BBC Sport|access-date=21 April 2011| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20110421035241/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/13110141.stm| archive-date= 21 April 2011 | url-status= live}}</ref>

==Match==
The match was scoreless after 90 minutes but there had been numerous scoring chances on both sides. [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] was credited with having three good chances in the first half, the last of which was kept out with a one-handed save by Barcelona goalkeeper [[José Manuel Pinto]].<ref name="Bar0-1RM"/> Barcelona did not have a shot on target in the first half, but in the second they dominated possession, with [[Andrés Iniesta]] and [[Pedro (footballer, born 1987)|Pedro]] both forcing saves from Real Madrid goalkeeper [[Iker Casillas]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Ronaldo's late goal gives Real Madrid win over Barcelona in Copa del Rey|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2011/apr/21/real-madrid-barcelona-copa-del-rey|access-date=23 April 2011|work=The Guardian|date=21 April 2011| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20110422152519/http://www.guardian.co.uk/football/2011/apr/21/real-madrid-barcelona-copa-del-rey| archive-date= 22 April 2011 | url-status= live}}</ref> The game was won in the first period of extra time by the game's only goal, a header from Cristiano Ronaldo from a cross from [[Ángel Di María]].<ref name="Bar0-1RM"/>

The BBC gave credit to Real Madrid manager [[José Mourinho]]'s defensive tactics for keeping Barcelona scoreless.<ref name="Bar0-1RM"/> When Barcelona's [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]], Andrés Iniesta, [[Lionel Messi]] and [[David Villa]] got the ball, they were challenged by two Madrid players.<ref name="Bar0-1RM"/> There were many fouls in the match, with the referee issuing eight [[Penalty card#Yellow_card|yellow card]]s.<ref name=SkyRep/> Real Madrid's Ángel Di María was [[Misconduct (association football)|sent off]] in the 120th minute after receiving his second booking.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2011/apr/20/barcelona-real-madrid-live|title=Barcelona v Real Madrid – as it happened|date=20 April 2011|work=guardian.co.uk|access-date=23 April 2011}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
Real Madrid players celebrated their victory that evening by riding a [[double-decker bus]] through Madrid where they were greeted by cheering crowds. While holding the trophy aloft, Real Madrid defender [[Sergio Ramos]] dropped the cup in front of the bus, where it was crushed.<ref name=CrushedCrown /> Ramos later joked that he had not dropped the cup, but that the cup jumped down to meet the fans.<ref>{{cite news|title=Sergio Ramos Drops Copa del Rey Under Moving Bus in Madrid|url=http://www.slate.com/BLOGS/blogs/trending/archive/2011/04/21/sergio-ramos-drops-copa-del-rey-under-moving-bus-in-madrid-video.aspx|access-date=23 April 2011|work=Slate|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110424050459/http://www.slate.com/blogs/blogs/trending/archive/2011/04/21/sergio-ramos-drops-copa-del-rey-under-moving-bus-in-madrid-video.aspx|archive-date=24 April 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref> The cup was replaced immediately with a spare version and placed in the Real Madrid museum.<ref name=CrushedCrown>{{cite news|title=Real Madrid given replica to replace flattened trophy|url=https://www.ctvnews.ca/mobile/real-madrid-given-replica-to-replace-flattened-trophy-1.634856|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201124114544/https://www.ctvnews.ca/mobile/real-madrid-given-replica-to-replace-flattened-trophy-1.634856|url-status=dead|archive-date=November 24, 2020|access-date=25 August 2020|work=[[CTV News]]|date=22 April 2011}}</ref>
